title: The thalamic nuclei of 67 healthy adults from diffusion MRI (MIAL67): seven nuclei or groups a hemisphere, on the MNI 152 ICBM 2009c asymmetric template at 1 mm
provider: E. Najdenovska, Y. Aleman-Gomez, M. Bach Cuadra and colleagues (CHUV and EPFL, Lausanne), served by TemplateFlow
format: NIfTI-1, gzipped, uint8 label values 1-7 (left) and 8-14 (right): pulvinar, ventral anterior, mediodorsal, lateral posterior-ventral posterior group, pulvinar-medial-centrolateral group, ventrolateral, ventral posterior-ventrolateral group; a table of names and colours, and the atlas's metadata.
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the atlas's metadata in TemplateFlow).
citation: Najdenovska, E. et al. (2018), In-vivo probabilistic atlas of human thalamic nuclei based on diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging, Scientific Data 5, 180270, doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.270.
